dmz-nav-download: Header link that opens the CurseForge/Modrinth dropdown. Same text as nav.download on dragonminez.com.
dmz-nav-discord: Header link to the Discord server.
dmz-nav-hairsalon: Header link to dragonminez.com/hairsalon. Same text as nav.hairsalon on dragonminez.com.
dmz-nav-wiki: Header link to the wiki main page.
dmz-nav-menu: Accessible label of the mobile menu button.
dmz-download-platform: Small caption under each platform in the download dropdown.
dmz-wiki-badge: Badge next to the logo and tag above page titles.
dmz-footer-rights: Footer rights line, after the year.
dmz-footer-description: Footer description, same as footer.description on dragonminez.com.
dmz-menu-options: Tooltip of the floating options button.
dmz-menu-close: Tooltip of the floating options button when open.
dmz-theme-light: Tooltip of the theme button while dark mode is active.
dmz-theme-dark: Tooltip of the theme button while light mode is active.
dmz-language-success: Toast shown after the language changes.
dmz-toc-title: Heading of the table of contents.
dmz-search-open: Accessible label of the header search button.
dmz-search-close: Accessible label of the button that closes the search overlay.
dmz-search-fulltext: Last suggestion in the search overlay. $1 is the query.
dmz-search-empty: Shown when no title matches. $1 is the query.
dmz-user-tools: Accessible label of the user menu.
dmz-translation-missing: Notice when the page is not translated yet. $1 is the reader language, $2 the language the page is shown in.
dmz-login: Footer link to Special:UserLogin for editors.
dmz-sidebar-character: Sidebar section heading, used from MediaWiki:Sidebar.
dmz-sidebar-world: Sidebar section heading, used from MediaWiki:Sidebar.
dmz-sidebar-reference: Sidebar section heading, used from MediaWiki:Sidebar.
dmz-sidebar-servers: Sidebar section heading, used from MediaWiki:Sidebar.
dmz-sidebar-creating: Sidebar section heading, used from MediaWiki:Sidebar.
dmz-sidebar-addons: Sidebar section heading, used from MediaWiki:Sidebar.
dmz-sidebar-project: Sidebar section heading, used from MediaWiki:Sidebar.
dmz-sidebar-toggle: Accessible label of the button that collapses the left panels.
dmz-more: Label of the page tools dropdown.
dmz-rail-label: Accessible label of the right column.
dmz-search-shortcut: Hint shown in the header search box.
dmz-rail-related: Right column card with pages that share categories or are linked from the current page.
dmz-rail-popular: Right column card with the most visited pages.
dmz-rail-recent: Right column card with the latest edited pages.
dmz-rail-version: Small label above the mod version in the right column.
dmz-rail-changelog: Button to the changelog in the right column.
dmz-rail-popular-pages:
{{notranslate}}
Curated fallback for the most visited card, one page title per line. Edit on MediaWiki:Dmz-rail-popular-pages.
dmz-sidebar-challenges: Sidebar section heading, used from MediaWiki:Sidebar.
dmz-sidebar-gear: Sidebar section heading, used from MediaWiki:Sidebar.
dmz-finder-placeholder: Placeholder of the Crafting Finder search box.
dmz-finder-empty: Shown in the Crafting Finder suggestions when nothing matches.
dmz-finder-loading: Shown while the crafting tree is being rendered.
dmz-finder-error: Shown when the crafting tree request fails.
dmz-heading-link: Tooltip and accessible label of the button shown next to each section heading that copies a link to that section.
dmz-heading-link-copied: Toast shown after the link to a section was copied to the clipboard.
